message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glaze && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"fuzzing/json_generic.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":13,"var":"json","code":"glz::json_t json{};","note":"The fuzzer creates a generic JSON DOM object that will receive attacker-controlled input."},
  {"step":2,"file":"fuzzing/json_generic.cpp","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":14,"var":"ec","code":"auto ec = glz::read<opts>(json, buffer);","note":"The raw input bytes are parsed into json_t through Glaze's JSON reader."},
  {"step":3,"file":"include/glaze/json/json_t.hpp","function":"read_json","line":360,"var":"buffer","code":"auto buffer = source.dump();","note":"Reading json_t first serializes the parsed DOM back into a JSON text buffer."},
  {"step":4,"file":"include/glaze/json/read.hpp","function":"read","line":44,"var":"value","code":"parse<Opts.format>::template op<is_padded_off<Opts>()>(value, ctx, it, end);","note":"The serialized buffer is then reparsed by the generic JSON parser, reusing the same attacker-controlled structure."},
  {"step":5,"file":"include/glaze/json/read.hpp","function":"skip_value<JSON>::op","line":171,"var":"*it","code":"switch (*it) {","note":"Parsing dispatches on the next byte and enters the object/array/string handling paths based on the input token."},
  {"step":6,"file":"include/glaze/json/read.hpp","function":"skip_object","line":52,"var":"*it","code":"while (true) { if (*it != '\"') { ctx.error = error_code::syntax_error; return; }","note":"When the value is an object, the parser walks each key/value pair and advances through nested elements."},
  {"step":7,"file":"include/glaze/json/json_t.hpp","function":"json_t::operator[](std::integral auto&&)","line":122,"var":"std::get<array_t>(data)[index]","code":"json_t& operator[](std::integral auto&& index) { return std::get<array_t>(data)[index]; }","note":"Array access uses unchecked std::vector indexing, so a malformed or oversized index can reach a container-overflow read sink."}
]
p.write_text('[\n' + ',\n'.join(__import__('json').dumps(x) for x in trace) + '\n]\n')
print(p.read_text())
PY
bash ./submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/glaze/fuzzing/json_generic.cpp /workspace/candidate_trace.json
